name: Office for National Statistics
niche: UK national statistical institute, labour market statistics
notes: Homepage offers English and Cymraeg. The About page names the UK Statistics Authority as the body it serves as executive office. Contact page lists offices in Newport, Titchfield, London, Darlington, Manchester, Edinburgh and Belfast; no headquarters is named. The /developers page returned 404. Government statistics office; its careers site (careers.ons.gov.uk) lists its own vacancies. No employer pricing, API, partner or parent company stated on the pages read.

review.note: Homepage, about, contact and careers pages returned HTTP 200 and state languages but no employer pricing, API or partner program.
